messages.content: Okay, working on that — one moment.

function.name: initiate_customer_reschedule
function.description: Initiates a reschedule for the customer's job. Generates 3 slot options (A/B/C) and texts them to the customer. Use when the customer says they need to move their appointment. After calling, tell the customer 'you'll get a text in a moment with three options — reply A, B, or C'.

job_id.description: The job id to reschedule (from customer's open_jobs).

reason.description: Brief reason the customer gave (e.g., 'work conflict', 'feeling sick', 'visitor in town'). Helps the office understand context. Optional but ideal.
